title: RBI imposes monetary penalties on Kotak Mahindra Bank, IDFC First Bank, and PNB
content:
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Friday announced that it has imposed monetary penalties on three commercial lenders—Kotak Mahindra Bank, IDFC First Bank, and Punjab National Bank (PNB)—for non-compliance with various regulatory directions.

According to RBI statements, Kotak Mahindra Bank was penalized Rs 1.5 crore for non-compliance with directions on customer protection regarding unauthorized electronic transactions. IDFC First Bank faced a penalty of Rs 1 crore for failure to adhere to statutory sanctions, while PNB was fined Rs 75 lakh for contravention of credit monitoring norms.

The central bank emphasized that the penalties are based on administrative and regulatory deficiencies and are not intended to pronounce upon the validity of any transaction or agreement between the banks and their customers.
